subject: Plan-memo offset keys (item 3): exact design needs a translator accessor; cost/benefit note before I start
body: What varies (c6m: offset=389 misses): bind offsets/lengths of non-layout buffer slots (CA's per-draw uniform ring). The generic plan reads them through (a) the BindShape (length_class(L) = bit length of padded(L); offset_alignment(b) capped at MAX_VERTEX_ALIGNMENT), (b) instantiate's descriptor_range(b, L, window, alignment A, max_range): lo=down(b+start,A), hi=min(round16(b+start+len), padded(L)), widened to 16, residual=b-lo pushed as SlotBindOffset, (c) SlotGuestBase pushes gpu_address+offset, (d) the uniform-aliasing check between disjoint and written slots. Exact templating: key a buffer record by (b mod A, offset_alignment class, length_class, Bounded window unclamped flag | Whole: padded(L)-b) and patch bind_offset/resource_length/descriptor_offset on a hit; refuse templating for slots with SlotGuestBase or when a written slot exists. The window/A/max_range/guest-base facts are pub(crate) in the translator (bind::plan::PlannedBuffer), so this needs a small public accessor in the pin (BindingPlan::buffer_templates) + a new air_bridge.rs export (texture-opus owns generic_plan_mode; mine would be a separate function). Benefit on device: c6m window 2 s: plan_ms=80 of draw_ms=474 (variant_ms 354 was mostly compiles, now handled by the fallback); turning ~330 misses/2 s (~80 us each) into hits saves ~25-35 ms per 2 s of encode-thread CPU (~1.5%). Starting now unless you redirect me; translator accessor goes in as a side patch for your commit like before.
